errors.text: The proposed intervention is not operationally defined: no alloying, heat-treatment, pressure, time, or cooling route is given for producing the coherent nanoprecipitates.
The supporting studies concern refractory BCC/B2 alloy systems rather than the relevant lamellar FCC/B2 eutectic alloy, so transferability is unestablished.
The experiment measures only macroscopic tensile properties and does not verify precipitate coherence, dislocation transmission, stress redistribution, or suppression of interfacial cracking.
